a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. I intend to take 4 now. I won't misrepresent my action. If you also take, the split is random. If we end up in a later round, I'll operate with you to refill the reserve.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more.
